summary: A near-white Porsche 911 GT3 R covered in faint grey ink art (feathers, thorny vines, roses) that echoes the artwork on a Monster Energy Ultra can, with cyan accents, a Monster claw and wordmark, and DELS #71 plates. The quiet grey detail is what makes it recognisable.
feel: almost white body, discreet grey ink detail everywhere, cyan pops, claw and plates as the loud elements

layers.what: grey ink feathers, thorny vines and roses
layers.where: all body panels: hood sides, fenders, doors, rear quarters, roof edges, rear deck
layers.notes: slightly darker than the body, thin dark outlines on the vines, denser around fenders and quarters, sparse on flat areas

layers.where: front fender, rear quarter, bumper corners, sills

layers.what: cyan lower stripe and splitter edge; cyan mirrors; cyan wing endplates and underside

layers.where: hood, roof, doors behind the plate
layers.notes: lighter grey on the hood and roof, dark on the doors

layers.what: MONSTER ENERGY ULTRA wordmark (door), MONSTER ENERGY ABSOLUTELY ZERO (nose, rear), MOTUL, GoPro, PORSCHE (bumper, wing), Papa's House of Game (rear deck)
T. THIELE with German flag; POTTSPEED on the side skirts
DELS #71 door plate cards; GRAN TURISMO windshield banner

overlapRules: Logos stay apart. The grey ink art is the lowest layer and runs behind and around everything. Plate text sits on its card. Nothing else overlaps.
provenance: Written by Claude from 15 reference photos (Gran Turismo 7 renders) on 2026-10-21; needs the user's review.
